title: A chapter's subdomain drops the Network's slug prefix (LIVE-1276)

source.ref: Owner 2026-10-22: chapters at encinitas.thegrouplocal.com, but the chapter slugs are the-group-encinitas (LIVE-1275).

detail: FILED AND CLOSED 2026-10-22. The Group's chapters are slugged the-group-encinitas, the-group-la-jolla and so on, so LIVE-1275 would have spelled the-group-encinitas.thegrouplocal.com. The chapter label now drops the Network's own slug prefix (chapterLabel), and the resolve tries the Network slug plus the label first, then the bare label, so encinitas.thegrouplocal.com reaches the-group-encinitas.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const h=fs.readFileSync('lib/sites/host.ts','utf8');const r=fs.readFileSync('lib/sites/hosted.ts','utf8');const bad=[];if(!h.includes('function chapterLabel'))bad.push('chapter label keeps the Network prefix');if(!r.includes('network.slug}-'))bad.push('resolve ignores the prefixed slug');if(bad.length){console.error('LIVE-1276: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
verify.note: Fails when a chapter host stops dropping the Network slug prefix or the resolve stops trying the prefixed slug.
